pages.h1: Bulletproof & Bombproof Vehicle Providers in Pakistan
pages.metaTitle: Bulletproof & Armored Car Services in Pakistan | 4S Security
pages.metaDescription: Hire or deploy bulletproof and bomb-proof vehicles in Pakistan. 4S Security provides armored vehicle services for VIPs, diplomats & corporate clients.
pages.body:
Who needs a bulletproof vehicle, and what do we provide?

Four Stars Security Services (Pvt) Ltd. is a security company and one of the bulletproof vehicle providers in Pakistan. We supply armored vehicles on booking, each with a trained driver, for people whose road travel carries more risk than an ordinary car is built for.

An ordinary car has no ballistic or blast protection. An armored vehicle adds reinforced doors, ballistic glass, run-flat tires and blast-resistant flooring around the passenger cabin.

Our clients are company executives, diplomatic missions, foreign delegations, institutions and families who face an elevated risk on the road. Bulletproof and bombproof are the terms the market uses. In plain words, armor lowers the risk from defined threats. No vehicle removes it.

Our armored vehicles and the protection they carry

Four Stars Security provides armored vehicles at the B6 and B7 protection levels, always with a trained driver. B6 is the level chosen against rifle fire, and B7 is for travel where the threat is higher. Every vehicle has reinforced doors, ballistic glass, run-flat tires and blast-resistant flooring. Before a client movement, each one is checked, confirmed as working and assigned to its driver.

At 4S Security, we provide a professional armored vehicle booking service , available for the days you need. Tell us about your security concerns, and we’ll help you choose the right armored vehicle to match your protection requirements.

How does bulletproof vehicle booking work?

Bulletproof vehicle booking with Four Stars Security starts with a short call about who is traveling, where and for how long. From that briefing, our operations team plans the movement and confirms the vehicle and the driver.

1: You share the dates, the passengers and the kind of risk involved.

2: Route assessment. Our team reviews the route and briefs the driver before the movement.

3: A driver trained in defensive and evasive driving takes the journey, and our team stays in contact with the vehicle throughout.

4: Your booking ends, or it continues into the next day of a longer contract.

Bookings run from a single site visit to a multi-vehicle convoy on contract. Service is currently available in Karachi and Sindh.

What every armored vehicle booking includes

Every armored vehicle booking with Four Stars Security covers the vehicle, the driver and the planning behind the journey. As a bulletproof security service provider, we include the items below in each booking.

  • An armored vehicle at the B6 or B7 protection level
  • Run-flat tires and blast-resistant flooring
  • A screened driver trained in defensive and evasive driving
  • A route assessment and a driver briefing before each movement
  • Coordination with our operations team during the journey
  • Vehicle documents and inspection records, available for the client to see

Why choose Four Stars Security for armored car services?

Four Stars Security is a government approved security company, incorporated in Karachi on 7 March 1994, and a member of the All Pakistan Security Agencies Association (APSAA). Our armored car services come from the same company that screens, deploys and supervises armed guards every day.

A difficult journey often needs more than a vehicle. You can add an executive protection team of retired Special Services Group (SSG) commandos, or our armed escort and bodyguard service, under one plan and one point of contact.

Management includes retired army officers, and we accept only the bookings we can deliver properly. See the rest of our security services, or book a bulletproof vehicle by sharing your dates with our Karachi head office.

pages.h1: Executive Protection in Pakistan by Retired SSG Commandos
pages.metaTitle: Executive Protection Services Pakistan | Retired SSG Commandos
pages.metaDescription: Elite executive protection services in Pakistan by retired SSG commandos. Armed escort, close protection & celebrity security by a government-approved security company.
pages.body:
What is executive protection, and who is it for?

Executive protection is planned close protection for one person or one family, delivered by a team instead of a single guard. Four Stars Security Services (Pvt) Ltd. provides executive protection in Pakistan with teams built around retired Special Services Group (SSG) commandos. The SSG is the special forces arm of the Pakistan Army.

Clients are chief executives, foreign investors, visiting delegations, senior officials, public figures and families whose profile or travel raises their personal risk.

It is different from hiring a bodyguard. A bodyguard stays beside one person. An executive protection team also plans the route, checks the venue in advance and manages the transport.

Our commandos are retired personnel employed by a private company. Neither the Pakistan Army nor the SSG runs or endorses this service.

Who is on a close protection team?

A close protection team from Four Stars Security has three parts: advance personnel, a primary protection officer and a support team. Each part has one job, so nothing is left to chance on the day.

  • Advance personnel visit the venue before you arrive and check entrances, exits and parking.
  • A primary protection officer stays with you throughout.
  • A support team handles communication and transport.

Retired SSG commandos bring habits formed over years of military service: reading a situation early, staying calm under pressure and working to a plan. Every team member is also screened for bearing, discipline, turnout and weapon handling, with background and reference checks. Teams carry licensed, non-prohibited bore weapons.

How does a protection plan work?

Every engagement for executive protection services in Pakistan begins with a security assessment by Four Stars Security. We map your daily movements, find where you are most exposed and review the security you already have. Your plan is written from that assessment, not from a template.

1: Assessment of your routine, your travel and your existing security.

2: A written plan that sets the team size, the roles, the vehicles and the communication.

3: A briefing and advance checks of each venue and route before the day.

4: Protection on the day, with the primary officer beside you and the support team managing transport.

Engagements run for a single visit, a business trip or a standing contract. At present we take assignments in Karachi and Sindh.

What our executive protection service includes

An executive protection assignment with Four Stars Security includes the assessment, the team, the planning and the transport arrangements. Where the risk calls for it, an armored vehicle joins the same plan.

  • A security assessment before the assignment starts
  • A team led by retired SSG commandos, with a primary protection officer
  • Advance checks of venues and routes
  • A briefing before every assignment
  • Licensed, non-prohibited bore weapons carried by the team
  • Transport coordination, with bulletproof vehicle booking where needed
  • Monitoring of the active assignment by our operations center

Why Four Stars Security for professional executive protection services?

Four Stars Security has worked in Pakistan since 1994, is a government approved company and is a member of the All Pakistan Security Agencies Association (APSAA). Our professional executive protection services are run by a management team that includes retired army officers. The company has guarded the Chinese Consulate in Karachi since December 2023.

Many clients come to us asking for elite security services in Pakistan. In practice that means a small, disciplined team, a written plan and supervisors who check the work.

If you need one officer for a day and not a full team, our private bodyguard service fits better. For a company function, see corporate event security. See our full range of security services for everything else.

To hire an executive protection team, contact our Karachi head office for a confidential consultation.

pages.h1: Mobile Force & Anti-Terrorist Squads Providers In Karachi Pakistan

pages.metaDescription: Rapid response mobile force and anti-terrorist squad services in Pakistan. Trained ex-military personnel for high-threat locations, industrial sites & critical infrastructure.
pages.body:
What is mobile patrol security, and when do you need it?

Mobile patrol security means guards who move through a site on a round instead of standing at one post. Four Stars Security Services (Pvt) Ltd. provides it together with a second service, Mobile Force and Anti-Terrorist Squads: armed teams that reinforce a client’s site when the risk level rises.

Guards at fixed posts are easy to predict, and a large site always has ground that no fixed post can see. Patrols close that gap.

Mobile patrols suit industrial sites, warehouses, large housing developments, financial institutions, construction projects and campuses. Both services add to static guards. Neither replaces them, and neither replaces the police.

Mobile Force and Anti-Terrorist Squads: what the teams do

Mobile Force and Anti-Terrorist Squads is the name of the armed rapid response service at Four Stars Security. A mobile force team reinforces the guards already on your site when the risk rises: after a threat is received, when an alarm is raised or while a high-value consignment is on the premises.

Each team has a clear chain of command, agreed communication procedures and members who know their role before a call comes in. Teams carry licensed, non-prohibited bore weapons and move in company vehicles.

Clients often describe this as a rapid response force in Pakistan, and some companies call it a quick reaction force. We quote no fixed response time, because distance and traffic decide it.

A mobile force team strengthens the site and holds it secure. Counter-terrorism operations and arrests are the work of state forces, and our teams do not carry them out.

How do mobile patrol security services work?

Mobile patrol security services from Four Stars Security start with a site assessment. We map the perimeter, the gates, the blind areas and the places where stock or cash is kept, then set patrol rounds whose timings vary from day to day.

1: Site assessment and a map of the points every patrol must check.

2: A deployment plan covering the rounds, the vehicles or motorcycles and the link with your static guards.

3: Patrols on varied timings, so a round cannot be predicted.

4: A log of every patrol, with an incident report whenever something is found.

5: Regular summaries for the client.

Officers and checking supervisors inspect guards at every location, including surprise checks, with daily reports to our General Manager and Executive Director.

What the service covers

As a mobile patrol security company, Four Stars Security covers both the routine patrol and the armed reinforcement under one contract. Coverage is available in Karachi ,Sindh KP and balochistan.

  • Mobile patrols on varied rounds across large sites
  • Mobile force teams that reinforce a site when the risk rises
  • Patrols by vehicle and by motorcycle
  • Agreed communication procedures between patrols, static guards and supervisors
  • Patrol logs and incident reports
  • Regular summaries for the client’s security or admin manager

Why Four Stars Security for mobile patrols?

Four Stars Security is a government approved security company that has worked from Karachi since 1994, and a member of the All Pakistan Security Agencies Association (APSAA). Patrol guards come from retired armed forces personnel and screened civilians, and each one is checked for bearing, discipline, turnout and weapon handling.

Clients who ask for an elite mobile security force are really asking for discipline and a clear command structure. A mobile force team is built on both. Where the need is urgent, guards can be arranged on 24 hours notice.

Patrols work best alongside cameras and trained people. Add CCTV installation for the ground between rounds, an armed escort for staff or valuables on the road, or a close protection team for senior visitors. See our other guarding and security services too.

Request a mobile patrol security quote and we will begin with a site assessment.

Corporate event security services place trained guards at a company function to control entry, check the guest list and keep the event orderly. Four Stars Security Services (Pvt) Ltd. calls this service Corporate Functions Security Coverage and provides it for companies, institutions and event organizers.

A function usually goes wrong at the door first: an unchecked guest list, a crowded entrance or guards who do not look the part.

Team size follows the event. A product launch with media present needs a different posture from a private dinner for the board. Guards are expected to be courteous as well as alert, because they are also the first people your guests meet.

Security guards for events: which functions we cover

Four Stars Security provides security guards for events held by companies and institutions: conferences, annual meetings, product launches, corporate dinners, award nights, exhibitions and private functions for senior guests.

Special event security for a chief guest or a visiting delegation can be combined with executive protection for the guest. Private event security is handled by a smaller, low-profile team that does not disturb the host’s setting.

1: Briefing call on the venue, the guest count, the timings and the risk factors.

2: A team plan that sets the number of guards, their positions and whether they are uniformed or in plain clothes.

3: Coordination with the venue management and your event planner before the day.

4: On the day, entry control, guest list checks and one point of contact for the organizer.

5: After the event, a debrief that records any incident.

You can also hire a security guard for a day when the function is small and one or two guards are enough.

What every event deployment includes

  • Uniformed guards with background and reference checks
  • Guest list and access checks at entry points
  • Coordination with venue management and event planners
  • One point of contact for the organizer throughout the event
  • Plainclothes guards on request
  • A post-event debrief that records any incident

Why Four Stars Security among event security guard companies?

Four Stars Security has worked in private security since 1994, is a government approved company and is a member of the All Pakistan Security Agencies Association (APSAA). When you compare event security guard companies, ask where the guards come from. Ours come from the same screened pool as our regular guard force: retired armed forces personnel and screened civilians.

Quotes are based on the guest count and the risk level of the event, not on a flat package.

A chief guest who needs personal cover can have bodyguard services added to the plan. A venue you use often may also need CCTV camera installation. Browse our security services for the rest.

Request a corporate event security quote from our Karachi head office, open Monday to Saturday.

CCTV installation for homes, offices and commercial sites

Four Stars Security Services (Pvt) Ltd. provides CCTV installation and maintenance for homes, offices, shops, warehouses and factories. CCTV installation in Karachi is our main area of work, and the service is available across Sindh.

Installation, monitoring and maintenance are three separate jobs. Installation puts the system in. Monitoring means someone watches the feed. Maintenance keeps the cameras and the recorder working. On this page you will find installation and maintenance.

Every CCTV security camera installation begins with a survey of the property. We find the blind spots and plan camera positions around how people really move through the place.

Security camera installation for businesses and homes

Security camera installation by Four Stars Security serves two kinds of client. Businesses get video surveillance installation for retail outlets, warehouses, offices, factories and residential compounds. Families get home camera installation for entry points, driveways and shared areas.

We install IP and analog cameras with DVR or NVR recording. A DVR records analog cameras, and an NVR records IP cameras.

Each system is tested and handed over with a working demonstration, so you know how to review footage before our team leaves. A camera records what happens. It does not stop it, which is why many clients pair cameras with guards.

How does CCTV camera installation work?

CCTV camera installation with Four Stars Security follows the same steps for one camera at a shop entrance and for a full security camera system installation across a commercial plaza. You receive a clear cost estimate before any work starts.

1: Site survey of the property.

CCTV camera installation and maintenance are two plans. Maintenance covers scheduled inspections, lens cleaning, storage checks and firmware updates, with a callout when a camera or a recorder fails. Your first maintenance visit takes place within three months of installation.

What every CCTV camera installation in Karachi includes

Every CCTV camera installation in Karachi by Four Stars Security includes the survey, the fitting and the handover. As a security systems installation service, we treat the handover as part of the job.

  • Cabling and mounting by our own trained technicians
  • DVR or NVR setup with storage sized to the system
  • Testing and a live walkthrough

  • A maintenance visit within the first three months

Four Stars Security is a government approved security company, working from Karachi since 1994, and a member of the All Pakistan Security Agencies Association (APSAA). Surveillance camera installation by a security company means your cameras are planned by people who also run guards, patrols and round the clock CCTV and electronic monitoring.

Cameras can be tied in with the guards on your site, so supervisors see what the cameras see. Our own trained technicians handle the work from survey to servicing, and nothing is signed off until it works.

Large sites often combine cameras with mobile patrol security, and busy entrances with lady searchers and female guards. See our security services for businesses and homes.

Request a CCTV installation quote and we will start with a site survey.

pages.body:
Why do bank branches need trained security guards?

Security guards for banks protect the people, cash and records inside a branch during banking hours. Four Stars Security Services (Pvt) Ltd. provides security guards for banks in Pakistan: screened guards for branch entrances, banking halls and cash counters, armed with licensed, non-prohibited bore weapons.

A branch holds cash all day and receives a steady flow of visitors, so the entrance and the cash area need constant watch. Security guards in banks also keep a busy hall calm and orderly for customers.

Banking in Pakistan has its own security guidelines for branches, covering how many guards a branch posts, where each one stands and how guards are screened. Banks also hire guards only from security companies approved for banking work.

The service is built for commercial banks, microfinance banks and other financial institutions that need security services for bank branches open to the public.

Bank security services: who stands where in a branch

Bank security services from Four Stars Security place each guard where the branch needs eyes most. Bank security guidelines in Pakistan call for at least two day guards at a branch, and a third where the safe holds a large amount of cash during the day.

  • Entrance guard: controls the door, checks visitors with a metal detector and stops anyone carrying a weapon from entering.
  • Vantage point guard: watches the banking hall, the cash counters and the vault door from a spot that sees the whole floor.
  • Third guard at larger branches: works as the ATM security guard or covers the parking or a second entrance during banking hours.
  • Women customers: checked by one of our women security officers where a male guard is not suitable.

Armed guards for bank branches carry licensed, non-prohibited bore weapons. The same guidelines expect a guard posted at a bank to do guarding only, never errands or other work, and never a double shift.

For a main branch, a regional office or any branch with a higher risk level, a bank can ask for retired Special Services Group (SSG) commandos in place of, or alongside, regular guards. Our retired SSG commando team also gives close protection to senior bank executives when they travel.

How does Four Stars Security deploy guards at a bank branch?

Four Stars Security plans bank branch security in five steps, from a branch survey to daily supervision. Each plan is written for one branch, because a small market branch and a large main branch carry different risks.

1: Branch survey: entrances, banking hall, cash counters, vault door, ATM and parking.

2: Guard plan: how many guards, which posts, armed or unarmed, and whether a female officer is needed.

3: Screening: each guard is checked for bearing, discipline, turnout and weapon handling, with background and reference checks.

4: Deployment and a briefing on the branch’s opening and closing routine.

5: Supervision: officers and checking supervisors inspect guards at every branch, including surprise checks, with daily reports to our General Manager and Executive Director.

We post security guards for banks in Karachi and across Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, managed from our head office in Karachi and our offices in Peshawar and Quetta.

What our security guards for banks cover

Our bank security guard services cover the branch from opening to closing and work alongside the alarm and camera systems the bank already runs. A bank security guard from Four Stars Security works from written duties for each post.

  • Entrance control and visitor checks with metal detectors
  • Watch over the banking hall, cash counters and vault door
  • Women customers checked by a female officer
  • Armed reinforcement from our Mobile Force and Anti-Terrorist Squads when the risk level rises
  • Branch cameras through our CCTV installation and maintenance service
  • Daily reports and surprise checks by our supervisors

Why choose Four Stars Security as your bank security agency?

Incorporated in Karachi on 7 March 1994, Four Stars Security is a government approved company and a member of the All Pakistan Security Agencies Association (APSAA). As a bank security agency it draws guards from retired armed forces personnel and screened civilians, which suits banks that prefer ex-servicemen at their branches.

Management includes retired army officers, and the company holds licenses for non-prohibited bore weapons. When you compare any security company for banks, ask to see its approval for banking work, its provincial license and its membership papers before you sign.

For an urgent requirement, guards can be arranged on 24 hours notice. See our armed and unarmed guard services, or request a bank security guard quote from our Karachi head office.

What do security guards for factories protect?

Security guards for factories protect a plant’s gates, stock, machines and people around the clock. Four Stars Security Services (Pvt) Ltd. is an industrial security services provider that supplies armed and unarmed security guards for factories in Pakistan. We guard textile and food units, warehouses and processing plants, and every guard works to a written gate procedure.

Most losses at a factory pass through a gate: raw material leaving in a truck, finished goods short on a delivery, or a visitor who walks past an empty post. A long boundary wall and quiet night hours add their own risk.

Owners, plant managers and admin heads hire guards to control what goes in and out, to keep watch after the last shift, and to keep a record of every vehicle and visitor.

Industrial security services: the guards and equipment on site

Industrial security services from Four Stars Security combine static guards at fixed posts with checks at the gate and, on large sites, a patrol on a round. Each post comes with written duties.

  • Main gate guards: visitor entry, gate passes and the vehicle register.
  • Vehicle checks: trucks searched on entry and exit, with under-vehicle search mirrors.
  • Store guards: doors, loading bays and stock movement checked against the gate pass.
  • Armed guards: for cash, high-value stock or remote sites, carrying licensed, non-prohibited bore weapons.
  • Women workers and visitors: checked by a lady security guard at the staff entrance.
  • Retired Special Services Group (SSG) commandos: for high-risk plants, sites with foreign staff, or whenever a client asks for them.

Our industrial security guard services run with walkie talkie sets, and a site can add metal detectors or walk through gates at staff entrances.

How factory security is set up and supervised

Factory security with Four Stars Security starts with a survey and ends with daily reports. Each step is agreed with the factory’s admin or plant manager, so guards enforce the factory’s own rules, not a template.

1: Site survey: gates, boundary, stores, loading bays, parking and labour entry.

2: Post plan: number of posts, armed or unarmed guards, and cover for every shift.

3: Gate procedure: gate passes, vehicle searches and outward material checks, written with the client.

4: Deployment and briefing, with a supervisor introduced to the factory admin.

5: Supervision: officers and checking supervisors inspect each post, including surprise checks, and report daily to our General Manager and Executive Director.

We post security guards for factories in Karachi and the rest of Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, with our offices in Peshawar and Quetta covering those provinces.

Warehouse security and what our factory guards cover

Warehouse security sits inside the same plan. A warehouse security guard from Four Stars Security works the doors and loading bays while the gate team controls vehicles, and together they cover the points below.

  • Main gate control, visitor passes and the vehicle register
  • Incoming and outgoing truck searches
  • Material checks against gate passes and delivery notes
  • Boundary rounds at night and on holidays
  • Store, warehouse and loading bay doors
  • Staff and labour entry and exit checks
  • Incident reports to the factory admin

Why Four Stars Security as your industrial security company?

posts.body:
If you have started calling around for quotes, you have probably noticed something frustrating: nobody gives you a straight number. Ask five security guards in karachi providers what a guard costs and you will get five different answers, usually followed by “it depends.” Guard pricing genuinely does depend on specific factors, and once you understand them, you can tell the difference between a fair quote and someone cutting corners. This guide breaks down what actually drives the cost of hiring a security company in karachi, what a realistic monthly range looks like in 2026, and what to check before you sign anything.

What Actually Determines the Cost

Guard pricing in Karachi comes down to a few things. Armed versus unarmed is the biggest swing factor, since armed guards need firearms licensing and additional training, so they cost noticeably more than unarmed static guards. Shift structure matters too: a single 8 hour shift costs less than round the clock coverage split across two or three guards. Experience level plays in as well, and guard count or contract length affects the per-guard rate, since most security guard service company providers offer better per-unit pricing on longer contracts than on a single guard for a short term.

What a Realistic Monthly Range Looks Like

As a general guide, unarmed static guards in Karachi typically fall in the range of 25,000 to 35,000 rupees a month per guard, with armed guards and specially trained personnel running higher depending on the risk profile of the site. Executive protection and specialized deployments like cash in transit escorts are priced separately. Any best security guard company in karachi worth hiring should be able to explain why your quote lands where it does rather than just handing you a flat number. A quote far below what others are offering usually means undertrained or underpaid guards, neither of which is good for you.

Business Sites vs Residential Properties

Commercial and residential security are not priced the same way, since the risk and duty requirements differ. A retail outlet often needs guards trained in access control and visitor logging, while a residential property usually needs guards focused on perimeter control. Businesses with higher footfall typically need more guards per shift, which raises the overall cost. Homeowners comparing security agencies in karachi should factor in whether they need a guard around the clock or just during specific hours, since that decision changes the monthly cost more than almost anything else. Guard experience and training level plays into pricing as well, a guard fresh out of basic training is priced differently than someone with years on commercial sites.

Local Karachi Providers vs National Security Companies

Some clients compare quotes from a local provider against a bigger security company in pakistan operating in Lahore, Islamabad, and Karachi all at once. National providers sometimes carry higher overhead from running multiple regional offices, which can show up in the quote even for the same job. That does not automatically make them worse, but it means company size alone is not a reason to pay more or less. A well run local provider with proper government approval can match or beat a national brand on both price and service quality.

What Should Be Included in Your Quote

A proper quote from security companies in karachi should spell out more than just a monthly figure. You want to know whether the price includes uniforms and equipment, whether replacement guards are provided if someone is sick, and what happens if you need to scale guard numbers up or down. Four Stars Security is a government approved security services provider in pakistan, operating out of Karachi since 1994, and every quote we give breaks these details down clearly before you commit to anything.

If you want an accurate number instead of a guess, the fastest way is to have your site assessed directly. Contact Four Stars Security and our team will walk your property, understand your actual risk and coverage needs, and give you a written quote that breaks down exactly what you are paying for. No inflated numbers, no vague line items, just a straightforward cost based on what your site actually requires.

FAQs

Q: How much does it cost to hire a security guard in Karachi per month?

A: Unarmed static guards typically range from about 25,000 to 35,000 rupees a month, with armed and specially trained guards priced higher depending on the risk level and duties involved.

A: Armed guards require firearms licensing, additional training, and carry more liability, all of which add to the cost compared to unarmed static guards.

DHA, Clifton, and PECHS are some of the more secure neighborhoods in Karachi on paper, gated entries, boom barriers, society patrols, yet break-ins, thefts, and unauthorized entry still happen in all three areas every year. Where Residential Security Usually Falls Short

Most homes in DHA and Clifton rely on either a single guard hired informally with no real vetting, or the assumption that the society’s main gate security is enough. Neither holds up well. What Proper Residential Security Looks Like

For larger properties, mobile patrol coverage that checks in periodically through the night adds another layer most single-guard setups do not have. Verified household staff, including drivers, matters too, since a lot of residential incidents in Karachi trace back to unverified staff rather than outside intruders.

Reputable security companies in karachi will answer all three without hesitation, and the same questions apply if you are considering a larger security company in pakistan instead of a local specialist.

FAQs

A: Yes. Pairing a guard with CCTV coverage means the property is monitored even in the moments a guard’s attention is elsewhere, and footage is available if an incident does occur.

A: Confirm they are government approved and properly registered, ask about their guard vetting and training process, and check whether they provide replacement guards when staff are unavailable.
